hero.title: Get what you need. Pay in clear monthly installments.
hero.body: See the full sale price and every due date before you accept. Your agreement is with the merchant, and you pay them directly. No interest is added to your installments.
hero.note: Fixed total price · clear dates · no interest added

sections.how: Know the total. See every payment date.
sections.howBody: Review the merchant’s fixed total price, installment amounts and due dates before you decide.
sections.why: No surprises from checkout to final payment
sections.whyBody: Your offer shows the agreed price and schedule up front. Customer installments do not grow with interest.
sections.pricingBody: A transparent platform fee for the tools you use. Never added to a customer's installments.
sections.final: Make every installment easy to follow.

steps.oneBody: Choose a fixed total price and a schedule that works for the sale.
steps.twoBody: Send a clear offer page with the full schedule and terms.
steps.threeBody: See what is paid, upcoming or overdue in one view.

customerSteps.oneBody: Check the full price, each installment and every due date before you decide.
customerSteps.two: Choose only if it works for you
customerSteps.twoBody: Accept the merchant’s offer after you understand and agree to its terms.
customerSteps.threeBody: Use the payment details in your plan and keep the schedule and receipts handy.
